Either can fill any of the three roles in a benchmark: the orchestrator you open here, the executors that perform the runs, and the judge that grades them. Mixing is fine (claude orchestrating, codex executing), and so is running everything on one. Opening it up to opencode and other harnesses is planned.\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/BuidlGuidl/ethskills-evals.git\ncd ethskills-evals\nyarn install\nclaude   # or codex\n```\n\nThen tell it which skill to check:\n\n```\nI want to eval the skill at https://ethskills.com/gas/SKILL.md\n```\n\nBefore anything runs, it interviews you. It reads `AGENTS.md`, drafts a task from the skill and shows it to you, then drafts the `expect:` lines and shows you those. The expect lines are the conditions the judge grades against, so this is the step worth slowing down on; they're the whole grading surface. Last it asks which executor to run and how many runs per variant. One question at a time, each with a recommended answer, so approving the whole thing takes a few words. Everything after that it does on its own.\n\nWhen the benchmark is done, everything it produced is still on disk, so you can keep asking the orchestrator questions (which run spent more tokens, what the failing run actually wrote) instead of re-running anything.\n\n## Layout\n\n```\nethskills-evals/\n├─ AGENTS.md                     the rules; the orchestrator reads this first\n├─ skills/                       vendored skill versions under test\n├─ tasks/                        task specs, one yaml per task (filename = task id)\n├─ scripts/setup-workspace.ts    seeds the clean workspace, hard-fails on grading leaks\n├─ scripts/verify.ts             snapshots a finished run, spawns the judge\n├─ lib/judge.ts                  the blind judge: evidence in, graded expects out\n├─ artifacts/                    per run: result.yaml + run.diff + output/ committed,\n│                                workspaces and transcripts gitignored\n├─ mistakes/                     mistake records mined from failures\n├─ reports/                      markdown comparisons per benchmark\n└─ templates/                    workspace seeds (gitignored; tasks record how to regenerate)\n\n# there is no runner. the orchestrator is\n# whatever agent you happen to open here\n```\n\n## How it works\n\nA benchmark is the same task run with the skill and without, a fresh executor per run, and raw pass counts per variant as the {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CeRupH3kb77HPSC93Q6md","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0163jaxFnd1y3WwuVK5TwKMZ","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > design.md <<'DESIGN_EOF'\n# forecast.example.com — service-side design\n\nA weather-forecast API that sells single calls to autonomous agents for **$0.35 in USDC on\nBase**, with no accounts, no API keys, no human anywhere in the loop, and no dependency on\nany directory we control.\n\nNothing here is invented protocol. The whole thing is four public standards glued together:\n\n| Need | Standard | Role |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| Be found, be identified | **ERC-8004** Identity Registry (Base) + **A2A Agent Card** at `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | permissionless onchain index nobody owns; card is the machine-readable manual |\n| Charge per call, no accounts | **x402** (`HTTP 402` + `X-PAYMENT`) | price, terms and receipt travel in the HTTP exchange itself |\n| Let a caller with zero ETH pay | **EIP-3009** `transferWithAuthorization` on USDC (via **EIP-712** signature) | caller signs, someone else submits and pays gas |\n| Be judged before being called | **ERC-8004** Reputation Registry (+ Validation Registry) | ratings are onchain events we cannot filter |\n\nEverything else in this document is the plumbing those four imply.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Shape of the system\n\n```\n                    ┌──────────────────── Base mainnet (eip155:8453) ────────────────────┐\n                    │                                                                    │\n                    │  ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry (ERC-721)   ERC-8004 ReputationRegistry │\n                    │      tokenId 4711 = us                     NewFeedback events      │\n                    │      tokenURI ──────────┐                        ▲                 │\n                    │                         │              ERC-8004 ValidationRegistry │\n                    │  USDC 0x8335…2913       │                        ▲                 │\n                    │   transferWithAuthorization                      │                 │\n                    └─────────▲───────────────┼──────────────────────┬─┴─────────────────┘\n                              │               │                      │\n                     (3) settle, gas paid     │            (5) rating / audit\n                         by facilitator       │                      │\n                              │               ▼                      │\n   ┌───────────┐        ┌─────┴──────┐  https://forecast.example.com  │\n   │  client   │        │   x402     │  ┌──────────────────────────┐  │\n   │  agent    │◀──────▶│ facilitator│◀▶│  server.ts               │  │\n   │ (USDC,    │        └────────────┘  │   /.well-known/agent-card.json  (free)\n   │  no ETH)  │                        │   /.well-known/x402             (free)\n   └─────┬─────┘                        │   /openapi.json                 (free)\n         │  (1) GET /forecast → 402      │   /forecast                     ($0.35)\n         │  (2) GET /forecast + X-PAYMENT│   /receipts/{id}                (free)\n         └──────────────────────────────▶│   /feedback-auth                (free)\n                                         └────────────┬─────────────┘\n                                                      │  (4) upstream weather\n                                                      ▼\n                                              api.open-meteo.com\n```\n\n## 2. Cold-start flow, end to end\n\nAn agent that has never heard of us, has 5 USDC, no ETH, and no human operator:\n\n1. **Discovery.** It queries the ERC-8004 Identity Registry on Base for agents — enumerating\n   `Registered`/`Transfer` events, or reading any third-party indexer of that contract — and\n   filters on the metadata/skill tags it needs (`weather`, `forecast`). It gets our `agentId`\n   and `tokenURI`. It never touches a catalog we run. (If it already knows our domain, it can\n   go the other way and fetch the card directly; see §3.)\n2. **Identity check.** It fetches the `tokenURI` → our Agent Card. It verifies the card's\n   `registrations[]` points back at *this* chain, *this* registry contract and *this*\n   `agentId`, and that `IdentityRegistry.ownerOf(agentId)` matches the key that signed the\n   card. Binding now holds in both directions, so neither a stolen domain nor a squatted\n   registry entry passes.\n3. **Trust check.** It reads `NewFeedback` events for our `agentId` from the Reputation\n   Registry, minus revocations; optionally `ValidationRegistry` responses from validators it\n   recognises; optionally USDC `Transfer` logs into our `payTo` address to confirm the\n   declared price matches observed reality and that many distinct payers exist. All free,\n   all reads, none of it served by us. It decides.\n4. **Terms.** `GET /forecast?lat=..&lon=..` with no payment → **HTTP 402** carrying the exact\n   asset, amount, `payTo`, network, timeout and the JSON schema of the response. Probing the\n   price costs nothing, so the agent learns the contract before spending.\n5. **Payment.** It signs an EIP-712 `TransferWithAuthorization` for 350000 USDC-atoms and\n   retries the request with `X-PAYMENT`. **It never sends a transaction, so it never needs\n   ETH.**\n6. **Service.** We verify the authorization, produce the forecast, settle onchain through the\n   facilitator (which pays the gas), and return `200` with the forecast, an\n   `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header containing the settlement tx hash, and a\n   **pre-signed feedback authorization**.\n7. **Rating.** The agent calls `ReputationRegistry.giveFeedback(...)` with that authorization\n   and a score. The score is an onchain event keyed to our `agentId`. Step 3 for the *next*\n   agent reads it.\n\nNo step waits on a person. No step needs a shared secret established in advance.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Discovery and identity\n\n### 3.1 What we publish, and where\n\n| Artifact | Location | Purpose |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| Agent Card (A2A + ERC-8004 extensions) | `https://forecast.example.com/.well-known/agent-card.json` | the manual: skills, endpoints, price, trust models, registrations |\n| Immutable card mirror | `ipfs://<cid>` (pinned) | survives our domain going away; used as `tokenURI` if we want the onchain pointer to be censorship-resistant |\n| x402 resource index | `https://forecast.example.com/.well-known/x402` | machine-readable list of paid endpoints + their payment requirements |\n| OpenAPI 3.1 document | `https://forecast.example.com/openapi.json` | request/response schemas for callers that prefer OpenAPI to the card |\n| Forecast archive + manifest | `https://forecast.example.com/archive/<date>.json` (hash committed) | lets independent validators score our past accuracy |\n| DNS TXT | `_agent.forecast.example.com` → `erc8004=eip155:8453:<registry>:<agentId>` | third leg of the binding; lets a client that only has the domain resolve identity without fetching HTTP first |\n\n### 3.2 What we register, before anything can find us\n\nOrdered, one-time, all executable by a script with no human approval step (`register.ts`):\n\n1. **Domain + TLS.** `forecast.example.com` resolves and serves a valid certificate. This is\n   the root of the offchain half of the identity.\n2. **Publish the card** at the well-known path. Do this *first* — the registry entry points at\n   it, and a dangling `tokenURI` is worse than no registration.\n3. **`IdentityRegistry.register(tokenURI, metadata[])`** on Base. ERC-8004 identities are\n   ERC-721 tokens; the returned `tokenId` *is* the `agentId`. Set:\n   - `tokenURI = \"https://forecast.example.com/.well-known/agent-card.json\"` (or the IPFS\n     mirror; the card then lists the HTTPS URL as its service endpoint).\n   - metadata entries for cheap onchain filtering, e.g. `domain`, `x402.payTo`,\n     `skills=weather.forecast`.\n   The registering key must be one held in our KMS — it is the key clients will check\n   `ownerOf(agentId)` against, and the key that signs cards and feedback authorizations\n   (or an explicitly delegated signer named in the card).\n4. **Sign the card.** Add a detached JWS over the card body in `signatures[]`, from the owner\n   key. Re-sign on every card change. Serve `ETag`/`Cache-Control` so clients can notice\n   changes.\n5. **Add the DNS TXT record** with the `agentId` you just got. This closes the loop:\n   registry → domain (via `tokenURI`), and domain → registry (via card `registrations[]`\n   *and* DNS).\n6. **Optional, never load-bearing:** submit to third-party indexes (an x402 bazaar/directory,\n   an ERC-8004 explorer, an ENS `text` record on a name we control). These are conveniences.\n   Discovery must remain possible with nothing but a Base RPC endpoint, and it does.\n\n### 3.3 The card (abridged)\n\n```jsonc\n{\n  \"protocolVersion\": \"0.3.0\",\n  \"name\": \"forecast.example.com\",\n  \"description\": \"Point weather forecasts for autonomous agents. $0.35/call, USDC on Base.\",\n  \"url\": \"https://forecast.example.com\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"capabilities\": {\n    \"extensions\": [{\n      \"uri\": \"https://x402.org/extensions/exact-evm/v1\",\n      \"required\": true,\n      \"params\": {\n        \"network\": \"base\",\n        \"asset\": \"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\",\n        \"assetSymbol\": \"USDC\",\n        \"amount\": \"350000\",\n        \"amountDecimals\": 6,\n        \"payTo\": \"0x…treasury\",\n        \"resources\": [\"https://forecast.example.com/forecast\"]\n      }\n    }]\n  },\n  \"skills\": [{\n    \"id\": \"weather.forecast.point\",\n    \"name\": \"Point weather forecast\",\n    \"tags\": [\"weather\", \"forecast\", \"x402\", \"erc8004\"],\n    \"examples\": [\"https://forecast.example.com/forecast?lat=52.37&lon=4.90&hours=24\"]\n  }],\n  // ERC-8004 additions\n  \"registrations\": [{\n    \"agentId\": \"4711\",\n    \"agentRegistry\": \"eip155:8453:0x…IdentityRegistry\",\n    \"signature\": \"0x…\"        // owner key over agentId|registry|domain\n  }],\n  \"trustModels\": [\"feedback\", \"inference-validation\"],\n  \"signatures\": [{ \"protected\": \"…\", \"signature\": \"…\" }]   // detached JWS over this card\n}\n```\n\nThe two directions a client can travel, and why both are checked:\n\n- **registry → domain:** `tokenURI` names the host. Proves whoever registered claims this host.\n- **domain → registry:** the card served over TLS by that host names the chain, registry and\n  `agentId`. Proves the host claims that registration.\n\nEither alone is forgeable (anyone can register a `tokenURI` pointing at a domain they don't\ncontrol; anyone can host a card claiming an `agentId` they don't own). Together with\n`ownerOf(agentId)` matching the card's signer, they aren't.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Payment: x402 over EIP-3009\n\n### 4.1 Why this satisfies \"no accounts, no keys, no prefunded balances\"\n\nx402 turns HTTP's unused `402 Payment Required` into the whole billing system. State lives in\nthe request, not in a customer record:\n\n- **Unpaid request →** `402` + `accepts[]`, one `PaymentRequirements` object stating asset,\n  amount, recipient, network and deadline.\n- **Paid request →** the same request plus `X-PAYMENT: base64(json)`, containing a signed\n  EIP-3009 authorization for exactly $0.35.\n- **Response →** the data plus `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE: base64(json)` with the settlement tx hash.\n\nThere is no identity to provision, nothing to revoke, nothing of the caller's that we hold.\nThe authorization is single-use (unique `nonce`, checked against\n`USDC.authorizationState(from, nonce)`) and short-lived (`validBefore`), so a leaked\nauthorization is worth at most $0.35 for at most a minute.\n\n### 4.2 Why the caller needs no ETH\n\nThe `exact` scheme on EVM uses **EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization`**, which USDC\nimplements. The payer's contribution is a *signature over typed data* — an offchain act with\nno gas. Whoever relays that signature onchain pays the gas:\n\n```\ndomain = { name: \"USD Coin\", version: \"2\", chainId: 8453,\n           verifyingContract: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 }\nTransferWithAuthorization {\n  address from; address to; uint256 value;\n  uint256 validAfter; uint256 validBefore; bytes32 nonce;\n}\n```\n\nTwo relay paths, in order of preference:\n\n1. **Facilitator** (default). We `POST /verify` then `POST /settle` against an x402\n   facilitator; it submits the transaction and pays gas. We never custody the caller's funds\n   and never hold ETH ourselves.\n2. **Self-settle** (fallback, `settleDirect` in `server.ts`). If the facilitator is down or we\n   don't want the dependency, we call `USDC.transferWithAuthorization(...)` ourselves from a\n   hot wallet holding a little ETH on Base. Cost is ~sub-cent per settle; the *caller* still\n   needs no ETH, which is the constraint that matters.\n\nNote EIP-2612 `permit` would also work but needs two transactions (approve-then-pull) and\nleaves standing allowance. EIP-3009 is one call, no residual state, and is what the x402\n`exact` scheme specifies — so that's what we speak.\n\n### 4.3 Server-side order of operations\n\n`verify → produce → settle → respond`. Verify first so we don't do work for a bogus payment.\nSettle before responding so we never hand over data against an authorization that turned out\nto be unsettleable. If `settle` fails after we produced the forecast we eat the compute and\nreturn `402` with the reason — the caller is not charged and can retry with a fresh nonce.\n\nIdempotency: keyed on the authorization `nonce`. A retry with the same nonce after a\nsuccessful settle returns the stored receipt and the cached forecast instead of double-charging.\n\n### 4.4 Failure modes we handle explicitly\n\n| Failure | Behaviour |\n| --- | --- |\n| No `X-PAYMENT` | `402` + full terms (this is the normal first request, not an error) |\n| Malformed / wrong-chain / wrong-asset / underpaid | `402` with `error` naming the mismatch, plus terms again |\n| Signature invalid | `402`, verified locally before we spend a facilitator call |\n| Nonce already used, or `validBefore` passed | `402 replay-or-expired` |\n| Facilitator 5xx | fall through to `settleDirect`; if that fails too, `402` and no data |\n| Upstream weather provider down | `502`, and **no settle** — we do not charge for an answer we can't give |\n| Settle succeeded but response lost in flight | caller re-requests with same nonce → cached receipt + forecast |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Reputation: making ourselves judgeable\n\n### 5.1 Ratings live in the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry\n\nAfter settlement, the caller calls:\n\n```solidity\ngiveFeedback(\n  uint256 agentId,       // ours\n  uint8   score,         // 0..100\n  bytes32 tag1,          // e.g. \"accuracy\"\n  bytes32 tag2,          // e.g. \"latency\"\n  string  fileuri,       // optional: caller-hosted JSON with detail\n  bytes32 filehash,\n  bytes   feedbackAuth   // signed by us, see below\n)\n```\n\nIt emits an event indexed by `agentId`. We are not in the read path: any agent can aggregate\nthose events straight from Base, and we cannot delete, hide or reorder them. Callers may also\n`revokeFeedback` their own entry, and we may `appendResponse` to dispute one — publicly,\nalongside the original, not instead of it.\n\n### 5.2 The authorization, and why it can't be used to suppress bad reviews\n\nThe registry requires the rated agent to have authorized the rater, otherwise anyone could\nspam ratings for an agent they never used. That authorization is an obvious censorship lever,\nso we defuse it structurally: **the authorization is minted at settlement, before the caller\nhas formed an opinion, unconditionally, for every paying caller.**\n\n```\nFeedbackAuth {\n  uint256 agentId;          // ours\n  address clientAddress;    // the payer recovered from the settled authorization\n  uint256 indexLimit;       // how many feedback entries this client may leave\n  uint64  expiry;           // generous — 30 days\n  uint256 chainId;          // 8453\n  address identityRegistry;\n  address signerAddress;    // ownerOf(agentId) or a delegate named in the card\n}\n```\nsigned EIP-712 by the owner key and returned in the `X-Feedback-Auth` response header and in\nthe receipt body. `/feedback-auth` re-issues it for any settled receipt, on demand, forever\nuntil expiry. We literally cannot know the score when we sign, and a client that finds\n`/feedback-auth` refusing a valid receipt has cryptographic proof of the refusal (a settled\ntx we won't honour) — which is itself reportable.\n\n*Exact field names and the EIP-712 domain must be pinned against the deployed registry's ABI\nbefore mainnet; they are isolated in one config block in `server.ts` for that reason.*\n\n### 5.3 The caller has no ETH — how does it pay for the rating tx?\n\n`giveFeedback` records `msg.sender` as the rater, so it cannot simply be relayed by us on the\ncaller's behalf without becoming *our* rating. Three answers, all standard, none requiring us:\n\n1. **ERC-4337 smart account + ERC-7677 paymaster** (recommended, and what we advertise in the\n   card): the caller's account is a smart account, a paymaster sponsors gas or accepts USDC\n   for it, and the bundler submits. `msg.sender` is still the caller's account.\n2. **EIP-7702** delegation for an EOA that wants the same sponsorship without migrating.\n3. **Any public relayer** that accepts USDC for gas.\n\nWe deliberately do *not* operate the relay. Sponsoring the write path of our own reputation\nwould hand us exactly the veto that §5.2 exists to remove. The card publishes a pointer to\nthird-party paymasters as a hint; the caller is free to ignore it.\n\n### 5.4 Objective quality, not just opinions\n\nWeather has ground truth, so opinion isn't the only trust signal available. We publish every\nforecast into a dated archive and commit its hash, then let independent validators use the\n**ERC-8004 Validation Registry** to score realized accuracy (Brier / MAE against observed\nconditions from a source we don't control) and post `validationResponse` onchain. A cold\nclient can then weigh \"strangers say 82/100\" against \"this validator measured our 24h\ntemperature MAE at 1.1°C\". The card advertises this via `trustModels:\n[\"feedback\",\"inference-validation\"]`. Validators are optional and unpaid by us; the archive\nis what makes them possible, so publishing it is on the launch checklist.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Dependency inventory\n\n### 6.1 Onchain (Base mainnet, `eip155:8453`)\n\n| Dependency | Address / identifier | Used for | If it's unavailable |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Base L1→L2 chain itself | chainId 8453 | settlement, identity, reputation | no settlement; serve `503`, or fail over to a second declared network in `accepts[]` |\n| USDC (FiatTokenV2_2) | `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`, 6 decimals, EIP-712 domain `(\"USD Coin\",\"2\")` | the money; `transferWithAuthorization`, `authorizationState` | nothing to settle |\n| ERC-8004 **IdentityRegistry** | env `IDENTITY_REGISTRY` — take the address from the ERC-8004 canonical deployment list for chain 8453; deployed deterministically, do **not** hardcode a guess | our `agentId`, `ownerOf`, `tokenURI` | already-discovered clients keep working; new discovery via registry stops |\n| ERC-8004 **ReputationRegistry** | env `REPUTATION_REGISTRY` | `giveFeedback` events | ratings can't be written |\n| ERC-8004 **ValidationRegistry** | env `VALIDATION_REGISTRY` (optional) | third-party accuracy attestations | lose the objective trust signal only |\n| ERC-4337 EntryPoint + a paymaster | client-side | lets a no-ETH caller submit its rating | caller must obtain gas some other way |\n| ENS (L1) | optional | human-ish name → card | cosmetic |\n\nWe hold **no** custody contract, no escrow, no subscription contract, no token. Deliberately:\nevery extra contract is a thing a cold client would have to audit before trusting us.\n\n### 6.2 Offchain\n\n| Dependency | Why it's load-bearing | Mitigation |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| DNS for `forecast.example.com` + TLS cert (ACME, auto-renew — no human) | one half of the identity binding, and the transport | short-TTL DNS, monitored cert expiry, IPFS card mirror as `tokenURI` so identity survives DNS loss |\n| Static hosting of `/.well-known/*` | discovery | serve from the app (as `server.ts` does) *and* mirror to IPFS |\n| **x402 facilitator** (`verify`/`settle`; CDP's hosted one on Base, or self-hosted) | pays gas so the caller needn't | `settleDirect` fallback with our own gas wallet |\n| Base RPC provider | nonce/authorizationState checks, `ownerOf`, direct settle | two providers, different vendors, health-checked |\n| Weather upstream — `api.open-meteo.com` (no key, no signup, so no human in provisioning either) | the actual product | second source (NWS/ECMWF) behind the same normalizer; short cache |\n| Key management (KMS/HSM) for: identity owner key, feedback-auth signer, settle gas wallet | forging any of these forges our identity or our reputation gate | separate keys per role, gas wallet holds dust only, owner key never on the web tier |\n| Replay/idempotency store (Redis; `Map` in the reference server) | prevents double-charge and nonce reuse | must be durable and shared across instances before you run more than one |\n| Receipt store | `/receipts/{id}`, re-issuing feedback auths | durable; receipts are the caller's proof they may rate us |\n| Forecast archive + hash commitments | makes independent validation possible | append-only object store |\n| Clock (NTP) | `validAfter`/`validBefore` windows | monitored skew; keep windows ≥60s |\n| Monitoring / alerting | detecting a stuck facilitator before callers do | — |\n\n### 6.3 What is *not* a dependency, on purpose\n\n- No catalog, marketplace or directory that we own. Third-party indexes are additive; the\n  primary discovery path is \"read a public contract on Base\".\n- No user database, API keys, OAuth provider, or billing processor.\n- No human approval anywhere: no signup, no KYC gate, no invoice, no support ticket, no\n  API-key issuance. The only human acts are one-time infrastructure setup (buy domain, fund\n  keys) — before the service exists, not inside any call.\n\n---\n\n## 7. What a cold client can actually verify (the trust checklist)\n\nEverything below is a read against a public source, costs no money, and needs no cooperation\nfrom us:\n\n1. `IdentityRegistry.tokenURI(agentId)` host == the host serving the card. *(binding, leg 1)*\n2. Card `registrations[]` == `{eip155:8453, this registry, this agentId}`. *(binding, leg 2)*\n3. Card JWS verifies under `IdentityRegistry.ownerOf(agentId)` (or a delegate the card names).\n4. Optional: DNS TXT `_agent.forecast.example.com` agrees with 1–2.\n5. `ReputationRegistry` events for `agentId`: count, score distribution, age, revocations, our\n   responses. Weight raters that are themselves registered agents with their own history.\n6. `ValidationRegistry` responses for `agentId` from validators the client already trusts.\n7. USDC `Transfer` logs to `payTo`: does observed volume match a $0.35 service with many\n   distinct counterparties? Cheap sybil check — fake reputation costs real money here.\n8. Free `402` probe: do the advertised terms in the card match the terms in the 402 body, and\n   is the response schema the one the card promised?\n\nIf 1–3 fail, stop: identity is unproven. 5–8 are how it prices the risk of the $0.35.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Endpoint surface\n\n| Method | Path | Paid | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| GET | `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | free | A2A card + ERC-8004 `registrations`/`trustModels`; `ETag` |\n| GET | `/.well-known/x402` | free | paid-resource index with full `PaymentRequirements` |\n| GET | `/openapi.json` | free | schemas |\n| GET | `/forecast?lat&lon&hours` | **$0.35** | x402; `402` without payment, `200` + forecast + `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` + `X-Feedback-Auth` with it |\n| GET | `/receipts/{nonce}` | free | settled receipt: tx hash, payer, amount, and the feedback auth |\n| POST | `/feedback-auth` | free | re-issue a feedback authorization for a settled receipt |\n| GET | `/archive/{date}.json` | free | past forecasts for independent validators |\n| GET | `/healthz` | free | upstream + RPC + facilitator status |\n\n## 9. Deliberate limits\n\n- **Single price, single asset, single chain.** `accepts[]` is an array precisely so this can\n  grow (Base Sepolia for testing, other chains, other stablecoins) without a protocol change.\n- **No refunds.** At $0.35, a refund flow costs more than the call. Instead: we don't settle\n  when we can't serve (`502` before settle), which removes most of the reason to want one.\n- **In-memory nonce and receipt stores** in the reference implementation. Swap for Redis +\n  durable storage before running a second instance; a forgotten nonce is a double-charge and a\n  forgotten receipt is a caller who can't rate us.\n- **ERC-8004 registry addresses and the `FeedbackAuth` struct/domain are configuration, not\n  constants.** The spec's reference deployments are the source of truth; pin them from the\n  canonical deployment list and the deployed ABI, and treat a mismatch as a launch blocker.\nDESIGN_EOF\nwc -l design.md"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":28642,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1870ccbc-87af-43d2-a7ac-2c7a911c4e2e","uuid":"f6463e94-5d16-4050-8fde-74bc9b14d81f","timestamp":"2026-08-26T19:31:52.673Z","request_id":"req_011CeRupGFdmrPRLLQ9ctbJa"}

env(\"PUBLIC_ORIGIN\", \"https://forecast.example.com\"),\n\n  // --- money -------------------------------------------------------------\n  chain: base,                       // eip155:8453\n  x402Network: \"base\",               // x402's name for it\n  usdc: getAddress(\"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\"), // Base mainnet USDC\n  usdcDecimals: 6,\n  usdcEip712: { name: \"USD Coin\", version: \"2\" }, // FiatTokenV2_2 domain on Base\n  priceAtomic: 350_000n,             // $0.35 * 10^6\n  priceDisplay: \"$0.35\",\n  payTo: getAddress(env(\"PAY_TO\", No accounts, no API keys, no human onboarding.\",\n    url: CONFIG.origin,\n    preferredTransport: \"JSONRPC\",\n    version: \"1.0.0\",\n    documentationUrl: `${CONFIG.origin}/openapi.json`,\n    provider: { organization: \"forecast.example.com\", url: CONFIG.origin },\n    defaultInputModes: [\"application/json\"],\n    defaultOutputModes: [\"application/json\"],\n    capabilities: {\n      streaming: false,\n      pushNotifications: false,\n      extensions: [\n        {\n          uri: \"https://x402.org/extensions/exact-evm/v1\",\n          description: \"Per-call payment via x402 (HTTP 402 + X-PAYMENT), EIP-3009 gasless authorization.\",\n          required: true,\n          params: {\n            x402Version: 1,\n            network: CONFIG.x402Network,\n            chain: caip2,\n            asset: caip10(CONFIG.usdc),\n            assetSymbol: \"USDC\",\n            assetDecimals: CONFIG.usdcDecimals,\n            amount: CONFIG.priceAtomic.toString(),\n            amountDisplay: CONFIG.priceDisplay,\n            payTo: CONFIG.payTo,\n            resources: [RESOURCE],\n            discovery: `${CONFIG.origin}/.well-known/x402`,\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          uri: \"https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8004#reputation\",\n          description: \"Feedback authorizations are issued to every payer at settlement time.\",\n          required: false,\n          params: {\n            reputationRegistry: caip10(CONFIG.reputationRegistry),\n            feedbackAuthEndpoint: `${CONFIG.origin}/feedback-auth`,\n            receiptEndpoint: `${CONFIG.origin}/receipts/{nonce}`,\n            // We do not sponsor the rating transaction — sponsoring the write path of our\n            // own reputation would be a veto. There is nothing to provision, so no security schemes.\n    securitySchemes: {},\n    security: [],\n    skills: [\n      {\n        id: \"weather.forecast.point\",\n        name: \"Point weather forecast\",\n        description:\n          \"Hourly temperature, precipitation, precipitation probability and wind for a lat/lon, up to 168 hours ahead.\",\n        tags: [\"weather\", \"forecast\", \"meteorology\", \"x402\", \"erc8004\", \"usdc\", \"base\"],\n        examples: [`${RESOURCE}?lat=52.3702&lon=4.8952&hours=24`],\n        inputModes: [\"application/json\"],\n        outputModes: [\"application/json\"],\n      },\n    ],\n\n    // ---- ERC-8004 -------------------------------------------------------\n    // Leg 2 of the binding: the domain asserts which onchain identity it is.\n    // Leg 1 is IdentityRegistry.tokenURI(agentId) pointing back at this document.\n    // A client checks both, plus that ownerOf(agentId) signed `signatures` below.\n    registrations: [\n      {\n        agentId: CONFIG.agentId.toString(),\n        agentRegistry: caip10(CONFIG.identityRegistry),\n      },\n    ],\n    trustModels: [\"feedback\", \"inference-validation\"],\n    trust: {\n      reputationRegistry: caip10(CONFIG.reputationRegistry),\n      validationRegistry: CONFIG.validationRegistry ? caip10(getAddress(CONFIG.validationRegistry)) : undefined,\n      // What an independent validator needs in order to score our past accuracy.\n      forecastArchive: `${CONFIG.origin}/archive/{yyyy-mm-dd}.json`,\n      settlementAddress: caip10(CONFIG.payTo),\n    },\n    // Detached JWS over this document by ownerOf(agentId). };\n};\n\nclass PaymentError extends Error {\n  constructor(public reason: string, message?: string) { super(message ?? reason); }\n}\n\nfunction decodePaymentHeader(header: string): PaymentPayload {\n  let json: string;\n  try {\n    json = Buffer.from(header, \"base64\").toString(\"utf8\");\n  } catch {\n    throw new PaymentError(\"invalid_payment_encoding\", \"X-PAYMENT must be valid JSON\");\n  }\n  const a = parsed?.payload?.authorization;\n  if (!parsed?.payload?.signature || !a) throw new PaymentError(\"malformed_payment\");\n  if (!isAddress(a.from) || !isAddress(a.to)) \"${req.network}\"`);\n\n  const a = p.payload.authorization;\n  if (getAddress(a.to) !== getAddress(req.payTo)) throw new PaymentError(\"wrong_recipient\");\n  if (BigInt(a.value) < The *caller* still needs no ETH, which is\n *  the constraint that matters. */\nasync function settleDirect(p: PaymentPayload): Promise<string> {\n  if (!settleWallet) throw new Error(\"no facilitator and no SETTLE_GAS_KEY configured\");\n  const a = p.payload.authorization;\n  const { v, r, s } = parseSignature(p.payload.signature);\n  if (v === undefined) throw new Error(\"signature missing v\");\n  const hash = await settleWallet.writeContract({\n    address: CONFIG.usdc, abi: USDC_ABI, functionName: \"transferWithAuthorization\",\n    args: [\n      getAddress(a.from), getAddress(a.to), BigInt(a.value),\n      BigInt(a.validAfter), BigInt(a.validBefore), a.nonce,\n      Number(v), r, s,\n    ],\n  });\n  const rcpt = await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash, timeout: 60_000 });\n  if (rcpt.status !== \"success\") throw new Error(`direct settle reverted: ${hash}`);\n  return hash;\n}\n\nasync function settle(p: PaymentPayload, req: ReturnType<typeof paymentRequirements>) {\n  try {\n    const r = await facilitator(\"settle\", p, req);\n    if (r.success === false) throw new PaymentError(r.errorReason ?? \"settle_failed\");\n    return { txHash: r.transaction ?? null, payer: (r.payer as Address | undefined) ?? getAddress(p.payload.authorization.from) };\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (err instanceof PaymentError) throw err;\n    console.warn(`[settle] facilitator failed, falling back to direct: ${(err as Error).message}`);\n    const txHash = await settleDirect(p);\n    return { txHash, payer: getAddress(p.payload.authorization.from) };\n  }\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *\n * 6. ERC-8004 feedback authorization\n *\n * Minted at settlement, unconditionally, for every payer — BEFORE the caller has\n * formed an opinion. That ordering is what stops this from being a censorship lever:\n * we cannot know the score at the time we sign, and /feedback-auth will re-issue for\n * any settled receipt until expiry.\n *\n * Field names and the EIP-712 domain below must be pinned against the deployed\n * ReputationRegistry's ABI before mainnet.\n * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\nconst FEEDBACK_AUTH_TYPES = {\n  FeedbackAuth: [\n    { name: \"agentId\", type: \"uint256\" },\n    { name: \"clientAddress\", type: \"address\" },\n    { name: \"indexLimit\", type: \"uint256\" },\n    { name: \"expiry\", type: \"uint64\" },\n    { name: \"chainId\", type: \"uint256\" },\n    { name: \"identityRegistry\", type: \"address\" },\n    { name: \"signerAddress\", type: \"address\" },\n  ],\n} as const;\n\nasync function issueFeedbackAuth(client: Address) {\n  const auth = {\n    agentId: CONFIG.agentId,\n    clientAddress: getAddress(client),\n    indexLimit: CONFIG.feedbackIndexLimit,\n    expiry: BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + CONFIG.feedbackAuthTtlSeconds),\n    chainId: BigInt(CONFIG.chain.id),\n    identityRegistry: CONFIG.identityRegistry,\n    signerAddress: (signer?.address ?? \"0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\") as Address,\n  };\n\n  const domain = {\n    name: \"ERC8004ReputationRegistry\",\n    version: \"1\",\n    chainId: CONFIG.chain.id,\n    verifyingContract: CONFIG.reputationRegistry,\n  } as const;\n\n  const signature = signer\n    ? await signer.signTypedData({ domain, types: FEEDBACK_AUTH_TYPES, primaryType: \"FeedbackAuth\", message: auth })\n    : null;\n\n  // Pre-encoded blob to hand straight to ReputationRegistry.giveFeedback(..., feedbackAuth).\n  const encoded = signature\n    ? encodeAbiParameters(\n        [\n          { type: \"uint256\" }, { type: \"address\" }, { type: \"uint256\" }, { type: \"uint64\" },\n          { type: \"uint256\" }, { type: \"address\" }, { type: \"address\" }, { type: \"bytes\" },\n        ],\n        [auth.agentId, auth.clientAddress, auth.indexLimit, auth.expiry, auth.chainId,\n         auth.identityRegistry, auth.signerAddress, signature],\n      )\n    : null;\n\n  return {\n    registry: caip10(CONFIG.reputationRegistry),\n    call: \"giveFeedback(uint256 agentId, uint8 score, bytes32 tag1, bytes32 tag2, string fileuri, bytes32 filehash, bytes feedbackAuth)\",\n    agentId: auth.agentId.toString(),\n    scoreRange: [0, 100],\n    suggestedTags: [\"accuracy\", \"latency\", \"availability\"],\n    auth: {\n      agentId: auth.agentId.toString(),\n      clientAddress: auth.clientAddress,\n      indexLimit: auth.indexLimit.toString(),\n      expiry: auth.expiry.toString(),\n      chainId: auth.chainId.toString(),\n      identityRegistry: auth.identityRegistry,\n      signerAddress: auth.signerAddress,\n    },\n    signature,\n    feedbackAuth: encoded,\n    eip712: { domain, types: FEEDBACK_AUTH_TYPES, primaryType: \"FeedbackAuth\" },\n    gasHint:\n      \"giveFeedback records msg.sender as the rater, so we cannot relay it for you without it \" +\n      \"becoming our rating. If you hold no ETH: ERC-4337 smart account + ERC-7677 paymaster, \" +\n      \"EIP-7702 delegation, or any public relayer that accepts USDC for gas.\",\n    note: signature\n      ? undefined\n      : \"AGENT_SIGNER_KEY not configured — this deployment cannot issue feedback authorizations.\",\n  };\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *\n * 7. The product\n * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\nclass UpstreamError extends Error {}\n\nasync function getForecast(lat: number, lon: number, hours: number) {\n  const url = new URL(CONFIG.upstreamUrl);\n  url.searchParams.set(\"latitude\", String(lat));\n  url.searchParams.set(\"longitude\", String(lon));\n  url.searchParams.set(\"hourly\", \"temperature_2m,precipitation,precipitation_probability,wind_speed_10m,weather_code\");\n  url.searchParams.set(\"forecast_hours\", String(hours));\n  url.searchParams.set(\"timezone\", \"UTC\");\n\n  let res: Response;\n  try {\n    res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000) });\n  } catch (e) {\n    throw new UpstreamError(`weather upstream unreachable: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n  }\n  if (!res.ok) throw new UpstreamError(`weather upstream returned ${res.status}`);\n  const d = (await res.json()) as {\n    latitude: number; longitude: number; timezone: string;\n    hourly: {\n      time: string[]; temperature_2m: number[]; precipitation: number[];\n      precipitation_probability: number[]; wind_speed_10m: number[]; weather_code: number[];\n    };\n  };\n\n  const h = d.hourly;\n  return {\n    location: { lat: d.latitude, lon: d.longitude, timezone: d.timezone },\n    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    source: \"open-meteo\",\n    hourly: h.time.slice(0, hours).map((t, i) => ({\n      time: t.endsWith(\"Z\") ? t : `${t}:00Z`,\n      temperatureC: h.temperature_2m[i],\n      precipitationMm: h.precipitation[i],\n      precipitationProbability: h.precipitation_probability?.[i],\n      windSpeedKmh: h.wind_speed_10m[i],\n      weatherCode: h.weather_code?.[i],\n    })),\n  };\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *\n * 8. HTTP plumbing\n * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\nconst jsonReplacer = (_k: string, v: unknown) => (typeof v === \"bigint\" ? v.toString() : v);\n\nfunction send(res: ServerResponse, status: number, body: unknown, headers: Record<string, string> = {}) {\n  const payload = JSON.stringify(body, jsonReplacer, 2);\n  res.writeHead(status, {\n    \"content-type\": \"application/json; charset=utf-8\",\n    \"cache-control\": \"no-store\",\n    \"access-control-allow-origin\": \"*\",\n    \"access-control-allow-headers\": \"content-type, x-payment\",\n    \"access-control-expose-headers\": \"x-payment-response, x-feedback-auth, x-receipt-id\",\n    ...headers,\n  });\n  res.end(payload);\n}\n\nfunction paymentRequired(res: ServerResponse, error: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) {\n  // The 402 body is the whole contract: asset, amount, recipient, deadline, schemas.\n  // Free to fetch, so a cold caller can read our terms before spending anything.\n  send(res, 402, {\n    x402Version: 1,\n    error,\n    accepts: [paymentRequirements()],\n    ...extra,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction b64(o: unknown) {\n  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(o, jsonReplacer)).toString(\"base64\");\n}\n\nfunction parseForecastParams(url: URL) {\n  const lat = Number(url.searchParams.get(\"lat\"));\n  const lon = Number(url.searchParams.get(\"lon\"));\n  const hours = url.searchParams.get(\"hours\") ? Number(url.searchParams.get(\"hours\")) : 24;\n  if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90) throw new RangeError(\"lat must be a number in [-90, 90]\");\n  if (!Number.isFinite(lon) || lon < -180 || lon > 180) throw new RangeError(\"lon must be a number in [-180, 180]\");\n  if (!Number.isInteger(hours) || hours < 1 || hours > 168) throw new RangeError(\"hours must be an integer in [1, 168]\");\n  return { lat, lon, hours };\n}\n\nasync function readBody(req: IncomingMessage, limit = 64 * 1024) {\n  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];\n  let size = 0;\n  for await (const c of req) {\n    size += (c as Buffer).length;\n    if (size > limit) throw new RangeError(\"request body too large\");\n    chunks.push(c as Buffer);\n  }\n  return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString(\"utf8\");\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *\n * 9. Catches smart-account signatures and balance problems that\n    // our local check can't, and does so before we spend anything.\n    const v = await facilitator(\"verify\", payment, requirements).catch((e) => {\n      console.warn(`[verify] facilitator unavailable, relying on local verification: ${e.message}`);\n      return { isValid: true } as { isValid: boolean; invalidReason?: string };\n    });\n    if (v.isValid === false) throw new PaymentError(v.invalidReason ?? No accounts or API keys.`,\n    },\n    servers: [{ url: CONFIG.origin }],\n    paths: {\n      \"/forecast\": {\n        get: {\n          summary: \"Point weather forecast (paid)\",\n          parameters: [\n            { name: \"lat\", in: \"query\", required: true, schema: FORECAST_INPUT_SCHEMA.properties.lat },\n            { name: \"lon\", in: \"query\", required: true, schema: FORECAST_INPUT_SCHEMA.properties.lon },\n            { name: \"hours\", in: \"query\", required: false, schema: FORECAST_INPUT_SCHEMA.properties.hours },\n            {\n              name: \"X-PAYMENT\", in: \"header\", required: false, schema: { type: \"string\" },\n              description: \"base64 x402 payment payload; body carries accepts[] PaymentRequirements\" },\n            \"502\": { description: \"upstream unavailable; not charged\" },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      \"/receipts/{id}\": { get: { summary: \"Settled receipt + feedback authorization\" } },\n      \"/feedback-auth\": { post: { summary: \"Re-issue an ERC-8004 feedback authorization for a settled receipt\" } },\n    },\n  });\n}\n\nasync function handleHealth(res: ServerResponse) {\n  const check = async (name: string, fn: () => Promise<unknown>) => {\n    try { await fn(); return [name, \"ok\"] as const; }\n    catch (e) { return [name, `error: ${(e as Error).message}`] as const; }\n  };\n  const results = await Promise.all([\n    check(\"baseRpc\", () => publicClient.getBlockNumber()),\n    check(\"upstream\", () => getForecast(0, 0, 1)),\n    check(\"facilitator\", async () => {\n      const r = await fetch(`${CONFIG.facilitatorUrl.replace(/\\/$/, \"\")}/supported`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });\n      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(r.status));\n    }),\n  ]);\n  send(res, 200, {\n    status: results.every(([, v]) => v === \"ok\") ? \"ok\" : \"degraded\",\n    checks: Object.fromEntries(results),\n    signerConfigured: Boolean(signer),\n    directSettleConfigured: Boolean(settleWallet),\n    agentId: CONFIG.agentId.toString(),\n  });\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *\n * 10. issueFeedbackAuth(receipt.payer) });\n    }\n    if (req.method === \"POST\" && path === \"/feedback-auth\") return await handleFeedbackAuth(req, res);\n\n    return send(res, 404, {\n      error: {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CeRvLPvq9PiKgJTSUg53m","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LKcPVxpc92W6qD6cBqXTPa","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > register.ts <<'REG_EOF'\n/**\n * One-time onchain bootstrap. Nothing can find the service until this has run.\n *\n *   1. the Agent Card must already be live at <origin>/.well-known/agent-card.json\n *      (a registry entry whose tokenURI 404s is worse than no entry at all)\n *   2. this script mints the ERC-8004 identity, whose tokenId IS the agentId\n *   3. put the returned AGENT_ID in the server env, restart, and add the DNS TXT\n *      record it prints — that closes the binding on all three legs\n *\n * Run:  AGENT_OWNER_KEY=0x… IDENTITY_REGISTRY=0x… npx tsx register.ts\n *\n * The IdentityRegistry ABI below follows ERC-8004 (identity is an ERC-721; registration\n * carries a tokenURI plus key/value metadata). Pin it against the deployed contract for\n * chain 8453 before running against mainnet — the address is a deterministic deployment,\n * take it from the canonical ERC-8004 deployment list rather than guessing.\n */\n\nimport { createPublicClient, createWalletClient, getAddress, http, type Address } from \"viem\";\nimport { privateKeyToAccount } from \"viem/accounts\";\nimport { base } from \"viem/chains\";\n\nconst ORIGIN = process.env.PUBLIC_ORIGIN ?? \"https://forecast.example.com\";\nconst CARD_URI = process.env.TOKEN_URI ?? `${ORIGIN}/.well-known/agent-card.json`;\nconst REGISTRY = getAddress(process.env.IDENTITY_REGISTRY!);\nconst RPC = process.env.BASE_RPC_URL ?? \"https://mainnet.base.org\";\nconst PAY_TO = getAddress(process.env.PAY_TO!);\n\nconst IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ABI = [\n  {\n    type: \"function\",\n    name: \"register\",\n    stateMutability: \"nonpayable\",\n    inputs: [\n      { name: \"tokenURI\", type: \"string\" },\n      {\n        name: \"metadata\",\n        type: \"tuple[]\",\n        components: [{ name: \"key\", type: \"string\" }, { name: \"value\", type: \"string\" }],\n      },\n    ],\n    outputs: [{ name: \"agentId\", type: \"uint256\" }],\n  },\n  { type: \"function\", name: \"ownerOf\", stateMutability: \"view\", inputs: [{ name: \"tokenId\", type: \"uint256\" }], outputs: [{ type: \"address\" }] },\n  { type: \"function\", name: \"tokenURI\", stateMutability: \"view\", inputs: [{ name: \"tokenId\", type: \"uint256\" }], outputs: [{ type: \"string\" }] },\n] as const;\n\nasync function main() {\n  const account = privateKeyToAccount(process.env.AGENT_OWNER_KEY as `0x${string}`);\n  const publicClient = createPublicClient({ chain: base, transport: http(RPC) });\n  const wallet = createWalletClient({ account, chain: base, transport: http(RPC) });\n\n  // Step 1 gate: refuse to register a tokenURI that isn't serving a card yet.\n  const probe = await fetch(CARD_URI);\n  if (!probe.ok) throw new Error(`card not reachable at ${CARD_URI} (${probe.status}) — publish it first`);\n  const card = (await probe.json()) as { name?: string; registrations?: unknown[] };\n  console.log(`card ok: ${card.name}`);\n\n  // Onchain metadata: cheap filters for clients scanning the registry before they\n  // fetch anyone's card.\n  const metadata = [\n    { key: \"domain\", value: new URL(ORIGIN).host },\n    { key: \"skills\", value: \"weather.forecast.point\" },\n    { key: \"x402.payTo\", value: PAY_TO },\n    { key: \"x402.asset\", value: \"eip155:8453:0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\" },\n    { key: \"x402.price\", value: \"350000\" },\n  ];\n\n  const { request, result: agentId } = await publicClient.simulateContract({\n    account,\n    address: REGISTRY,\n    abi: IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ABI,\n    functionName: \"register\",\n    args: [CARD_URI, metadata],\n  });\n  const hash = await wallet.writeContract(request);\n  const receipt = await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });\n  if (receipt.status !== \"success\") throw new Error(`register reverted: ${hash}`);\n\n  const owner = (await publicClient.readContract({\n    address: REGISTRY, abi: IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ABI, functionName: \"ownerOf\", args: [agentId],\n  })) as Address;\n\n  console.log(`\nregistered\n  agentId      ${agentId}\n  registry     eip155:8453:${REGISTRY}\n  tokenURI     ${CARD_URI}\n  owner        ${owner}\n  tx           ${hash}\n\nnext, in order:\n  1. AGENT_ID=${agentId} in the server env, restart  (the card then advertises registrations[])\n  2. sign the card with ${owner} and put the detached JWS in card.signatures[]\n  3. DNS TXT  _agent.${new URL(ORIGIN).host}  ->  \"erc8004=eip155:8453:${REGISTRY}:${agentId}\"\n  4. verify both legs of the binding resolve:\n       tokenURI(${agentId}) host == ${new URL(ORIGIN).host}\n       card.registrations[0]     == eip155:8453:${REGISTRY} / ${agentId}\n`);\n}\n\nmain().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });\nREG_EOF\n\ncat > package.json <<'PKG_EOF'\n{\n  \"name\": \"forecast-example-com\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"private\": true,\n  \"type\": \"module\",\n  \"description\": \"Weather forecasts for autonomous agents. $0.35/call, USDC on Base, x402 + ERC-8004.\",\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"start\": \"tsx server.ts\",\n    \"dev\": \"tsx watch server.ts\",\n    \"register\": \"tsx register.ts\",\n    \"typecheck\": \"tsc --noEmit\"\n  },\n  \"dependencies\": {\n    \"viem\": \"^2.21.0\"\n  },\n  \"devDependencies\": {\n    \"@types/node\": \"^22.0.0\",\n    \"tsx\": \"^4.19.0\",\n    \"typescript\": \"^5.6.0\"\n  }\n}\nPKG_EOF\n\ncat > tsconfig.json <<'TS_EOF'\n{\n  \"compilerOptions\": {\n    \"target\": \"ES2022\",\n    \"lib\": [\"ES2023\", \"DOM\"],\n    \"module\": \"ESNext\",\n    \"moduleResolution\": \"bundler\",\n    \"strict\": true,\n    \"noEmit\": true,\n    \"skipLibCheck\": true,\n    \"esModuleInterop\": true,\n    \"types\": [\"node\"]\n  },\n  \"include\": [\"*.ts\"]\n}\nTS_EOF\n\ncat > .env.example <<'ENV_EOF'\n# --- public identity -------------------------------------------------------\nPUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://forecast.example.com\nPORT=8402\n\n# --- money (Base mainnet, eip155:8453) -------------------------------------\nPAY_TO=0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000        # where the $0.35 lands\nBASE_RPC_URL=https://mainnet.base.org                    # use two providers in production\n\n# x402 facilitator: submits the caller's EIP-3009 authorization and pays the gas,\n# which is what lets a caller holding only USDC pay us.\nX402_FACILITATOR_URL=https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402\nX402_FACILITATOR_AUTH=                                   # \"Bearer …\" if the facilitator requires it\n\n# --- ERC-8004 (pin from the canonical deployment list for chain 8453) ------\nIDENTITY_REGISTRY=0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\nREPUTATION_REGISTRY=0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\nVALIDATION_REGISTRY=\nAGENT_ID=0                                               # set from register.ts output\n\n# --- keys (KMS/HSM in production; raw hex is dev only) ---------------------\nAGENT_OWNER_KEY=      # owns the ERC-8004 identity NFT; register.ts only, never on the web tier\nAGENT_SIGNER_KEY=     # signs agent cards + feedback authorizations\nSETTLE_GAS_KEY=       # dust-funded fallback wallet, used only if the facilitator is down\n\n# --- product ---------------------------------------------------------------\nWEATHER_UPSTREAM=https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast  # no key, no signup, no human\nENV_EOF\nls -la"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":16189,"cache_read_input_tokens":45498,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":16189},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1870ccbc-87af-43d2-a7ac-2c7a911c4e2e","uuid":"0bc43007-d17e-4fd7-9892-f2115af9dcdf","timestamp":"2026-08-26T19:35:15.671Z","request_id":"req_011CeRvLP4F3TPFuu8QFfpTA"}

randomBytes } from \"node:crypto\";\n\nconst acct = privateKeyToAccount(\"0x59c6995e998f97a5a0044966f0945389dc9e86dae88c7a8412f4603b6b78690d\");\nconst B = \"http://localhost:8493\";\n\n// 1. free value: terms.maxAmountRequired,\n  validAfter: \"0\",\n  validBefore: String(now + terms.maxTimeoutSeconds),\n  nonce: toHex(randomBytes(32)),\n};\nconst signature = await acct.signTypedData({\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CeRvf1gu3fhvLhwLQqwMT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Built and tested. Files in the workspace:\n\n| File | What it is |\n|---|---|\n| `design.md` | architecture, full dependency inventory, publish/register checklist |\n| `server.ts` | the HTTP server (941 lines, typechecks clean, smoke-tested) |\n| `register.ts` | the one-time onchain bootstrap — nothing can find you until this runs |\n| `.env.example`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` | runnable as-is |\n\n**The four standards, one per constraint:**\n\n- **Discovery without a catalog you own** — ERC-8004 Identity Registry on Base. Your identity is an ERC-721; `tokenId` *is* your `agentId`. A cold client enumerates a public contract, nobody's gatekeeper. The binding is checked on two legs: `tokenURI(agentId)` names your host, and the A2A Agent Card that host serves at `/.well-known/agent-card.json` names the chain, registry and `agentId` back. Either alone is forgeable — anyone can register a `tokenURI` for a domain they don't control, anyone can host a card claiming an id they don't own. Both, plus a card JWS from `ownerOf(agentId)`, isn't. A DNS TXT record is the third leg.\n- **Per-call billing, no accounts** — x402. Unpaid request gets a `402` carrying the full terms (free to probe); the retry carries `X-PAYMENT`. State lives in the request, so there's nothing to provision or revoke and nothing of the caller's held.\n- **USDC but no ETH** — the `exact` scheme uses EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization`. The payer's whole contribution is an EIP-712 signature, an offchain act. The facilitator submits and pays gas; `settleDirect` is the fallback from a dust-funded wallet if the facilitator is down.\n- **Ratings others can act on** — ERC-8004 Reputation Registry. The registry requires the rated agent to authorize the rater, which is an obvious censorship lever, so it's defused by ordering: the `FeedbackAuth` is signed at settlement, unconditionally, *before* the caller has an opinion, and `/feedback-auth` re-issues for any settled receipt. We can't know the score when we sign it. We deliberately don't sponsor the rating transaction either — that would hand back the veto; the card points at third-party ERC-4337/ERC-7677 paymasters instead.\n\n**Verified end to end** against a live Open-Meteo upstream and Base RPC: 402→sign→200 with a real forecast; replayed nonce returns the cached receipt rather than double-charging; same nonce on a different request is rejected; tampered signature, underpayment and wrong network all rejected before any work. Settlement itself was stubbed for the 200 path — no facilitator credentials or funded key here — and that stub is not in the delivered file; the unstubbed run failed exactly at `settleDirect`, uncharged, which is the intended path.\n\nTwo things I could not pin from here and flagged as launch blockers in `design.md`: the **ERC-8004 registry addresses** for chain 8453 (deterministic deployments — take them from the canonical list, don't guess) and the **`FeedbackAuth` struct/domain** (pin against the deployed ABI). Both are isolated in one config block. Separately: this implements **x402 v1** (`X-PAYMENT`, `network: \"base\"`); if a later revision is current it renames the headers and moves `network` to a CAIP-2 id — worth checking, though the EIP-3009 signature underneath is unchanged."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":821,"cache_read_input_tokens":84481,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":821},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1870ccbc-87af-43d2-a7ac-2c7a911c4e2e","uuid":"5f26150e-fb05-4c92-b85c-18fc05f5e553","timestamp":"2026-08-26T19:39:07.681Z","request_id":"req_011CeRvezj6pDcWWqxetbfzh"}
